item.title: Inkvolt PDF 1.8.0
item.description:
Inkvolt PDF speaks Spanish, prints pages sharp instead of as pictures, and keeps working on files made to freeze it. Scanning gets presets and leaves out blank pages, and Snapshot copies part of a page as a picture.
- Inkvolt PDF speaks Spanish: menus, windows, messages, reports and What's New follow the language you choose for it in macOS (System Settings › General › Language & Region › Applications) or in Settings › Language. - Printing sends pages as they are, not as pictures: text and lines stay sharp at any size, and print jobs are many times smaller and faster to send. A long scan is ready to print in about a second. - Printing to a printer Inkvolt Print knows shows its state and toner in the print panel, and warns in red when it's off or has a problem such as a paper jam, before you press Print. File › Printer Settings opens Inkvolt Print. - Scan lists the scanners Inkvolt Print knows straight away; Save as Preset… keeps your scan choices under a name; blank pages are left out (on by default), and the message says how many. - Snapshot (Tools › Snapshot, ⌥⌘C): drag over part of a page to copy it as a picture, sharp enough to paste into a document or an email. - Make Accessible reads the bitmap fonts of older TeX papers, tags each heading and paragraph inside a drawing placed on the page, and reads a table cell that spans rows as one cell. The Reading Order pane can change what a piece is (heading, paragraph, caption, footnote, formula, picture). - Batch's Recognize Text reads scans as Tools › Recognize Text does and keeps the words it wasn't sure of for review; exports from scanned pages say how many suspect words there were. - A page built to take minutes to read no longer freezes the app: after a few seconds it says so, and the rest of the document can still be used. Find, Redact by Pattern, Prepare Form, Recognize Text and the AI assistant go on with the other pages and say which they skipped. - Redaction never passes a page it couldn't read: Batch's Redact Patterns and Check Redaction fail that file and save nothing, and Check Redaction says when it couldn't look at everything, and which pages. - Batch presets, form data files and the AI assistant's answers can't stop the app with deeply nested JSON.

Inkvolt PDF habla español, imprime las páginas nítidas en lugar de como imágenes y sigue funcionando con archivos hechos para congelarla. Escanear tiene ajustes predefinidos y omite las páginas en blanco, y Captura copia parte de una página como imagen.
- Inkvolt PDF habla español: los menús, las ventanas, los mensajes, los informes y Novedades siguen el idioma que elijas para él en macOS (Configuración del Sistema › General › Idioma y región › Aplicaciones) o en Configuración › Idioma. - Al imprimir, las páginas se envían tal como son, no como imágenes: el texto y las líneas se ven nítidos a cualquier tamaño, y los trabajos de impresión son muchas veces más pequeños y rápidos de enviar. Un escaneo largo está listo para imprimir en cerca de un segundo. - Al imprimir en una impresora que Inkvolt Print conoce, el panel de impresión muestra su estado y su tóner, y avisa en rojo si está apagada o tiene un problema, como un atasco de papel, antes de que presiones Imprimir. Archivo › Configuración de la impresora abre Inkvolt Print. - Escanear muestra enseguida los escáneres que Inkvolt Print conoce; Guardar como ajuste predefinido… guarda tus opciones de escaneo con un nombre; las páginas en blanco se omiten (activado de forma predeterminada) y el mensaje dice cuántas. - Captura (Herramientas › Captura, ⌥⌘C): arrastra sobre parte de una página para copiarla como imagen, con la nitidez suficiente para pegarla en un documento o un correo electrónico. - Hacer accesible lee las fuentes de mapa de bits de los artículos antiguos hechos con TeX, etiqueta cada encabezado y cada párrafo dentro de un dibujo colocado en la página, y lee como una sola celda la celda de una tabla que abarca varias filas. El panel Orden de lectura puede cambiar qué es una pieza (encabezado, párrafo, leyenda, nota al pie, fórmula, imagen). - Reconocer texto en En lote lee los escaneos como Herramientas › Reconocer texto y guarda para revisarlas las palabras de las que no estaba seguro; las exportaciones de páginas escaneadas dicen cuántas palabras dudosas había. - Una página hecha para tardar minutos en leerse ya no congela la app: a los pocos segundos lo dice, y el resto del documento se puede seguir usando. Buscar, Eliminar por patrón, Preparar formulario, Reconocer texto y el asistente de IA siguen con las demás páginas y dicen cuáles omitieron. - La eliminación nunca da por buena una página que no pudo leer: Eliminar por patrón y Comprobar eliminación en En lote hacen fallar ese archivo y no guardan nada, y Comprobar eliminación dice cuándo no pudo revisarlo todo, y qué páginas. - Los ajustes predefinidos de En lote, los archivos de datos de formulario y las respuestas del asistente de IA no pueden detener la app con JSON anidado a gran profundidad.

item.title: Inkvolt PDF 1.7.0
item.description:
Comments and form data travel: export and import comments as XFDF, FDF or CSV, form data as CSV and JSON too, one filled form per spreadsheet row, and a printable summary of a document's comments. One Inkvolt Pro key now counts in both Mac apps.
- Export and import comments (Tools › Annotate): XFDF for Acrobat and other PDF apps, FDF, or a CSV for spreadsheets. Replies, colors, authors and shapes come along; importing adds only what the document doesn't have yet, and one Undo takes it back. - Form data as CSV and JSON too (File › Form Data): values are checked against their fields, and the ones the form doesn't take are listed. - Fill Forms from CSV (File › Form Data): one filled copy of the form for each row of a spreadsheet, named as you like (any column can go in the name); rows the form refuses are listed in a report. Also from Terminal: `--fill`. - Summarize Comments (Tools › Annotate): a PDF with each page beside its numbered list of comments and replies, ready to print or send. - Batch can export comments (XFDF, FDF, CSV), form data (XFDF, FDF, CSV, JSON) and comment summaries for many files at once. - Recognize Text turns a page over only when it reads clearly better that way, so a scanned page of numbers, which reads much the same either way up, stays as it is. - One Inkvolt Pro key for both Mac apps: a key entered in Inkvolt PDF counts in Inkvolt Print, and the other way round (Help › Inkvolt Pro…). A key you entered before moves over by itself.

item.title: Inkvolt PDF 1.6.1
item.description:
Fixes for three problems a damaged or unusual file, or an unusual value, could cause.
- Go to Page no longer hangs on a PDF with thousands of page-number styles or a very long page-label prefix. - Typing "inf" or a huge number as a watermark's picture width no longer makes Add Watermark quit the app the next time; Crop Pages refuses it too. - Document Properties stays on screen for a PDF whose producer or creator text is very long: it's shortened on one line.

item.title: Inkvolt PDF 1.6.0
item.description:
A calmer window, simpler dialogs, rotate view, dark pages, reading modes, saved signatures, and many smaller things from the Windows app.
- A calmer window: a toolbar like Preview's (sidebar, zoom, Highlight, Markup, Fill & Sign, Share, Search), the markup tools in a bar under it when you want them, and a Tools menu grouped by what you're doing. Every tool keeps its shortcut. - Simpler dialogs: the choices most people need are in sight, the rest under More Options. The start page shows your recent files first and four tools, and the sidebar shows only the panes your document has. Settings apply as soon as you change them. - Reading: Single Page (⌘4), Continuous (⌘5), Two Pages (⌘6) and Two Pages with Cover (⌘7); rotate the view (⇧⌘R, ⇧⌘L) without changing the file; dark pages for night reading; Go to Page (⌥⌘G); the zoom in the window's subtitle. - Fill & Sign keeps your signatures and initials between launches. Forms whose fields react to the pointer now do. - Pages: drag thumbnails to move pages or copy them to another window, and drop PDFs or pictures from the Finder. Reverse Page Order, Extract Pages as one file or a file per page, Split Document, and Insert from Scanner into the open document. - Edit Text & Images: resize pictures by their handles and move them with the arrow keys. - Document Properties (⇧⌘I), Share, an attached PDF with its own password opens, exports follow the layers you show, Compare Files zooms, and Help › Report a Problem. - Fixed: closing a document right after moving a form field with the arrow keys no longer loses the move; a picture keeps its selection after a move; windows can be made much narrower.

item.title: Inkvolt PDF 1.5.0
item.description:
Make PDFs from Office files and web pages, Read Aloud, attachments and layers, split view, cleaner OCR, export to PowerPoint and HTML, and a much faster Find.
- Find is several times faster on long documents (it reads pages on all but one of the Mac's cores, and remembers them for your next search), and a new search stops the one before it. Large files take about half the memory they did. - Export to PowerPoint and HTML (File › Export To, and Batch): a slide per page with editable text boxes, headings as slide titles, tables, pictures and simple shapes; or one web page that reflows on any screen, with the alternate text the PDF's tags give, and no scripts or anything loaded from elsewhere. - Recognize Text (OCR) cleans scanned pages first: it straightens them (up to 15°), turns sideways and upside-down pages upright, removes specks and evens out grey paper, and can replace the scans with the cleaned pages. Choose the language, or let it detect it. Words worth a second look (not in the dictionary, letters and digits mixed, odd characters) are listed in the sidebar's Suspect Words with their picture from the page: correct them or keep them as read (Tools › Review Suspect Words). - Split view (View › Split View): the same document in two panes, top and bottom or side by side, each with its own page and zoom, to read two places at once. An edit in one shows in the other at once. Click a pane, or press ⌘', to switch; the × closes the second pane. - Attachments and Layers in the sidebar (View › Show Attachments ⌥⌘5, Show Layers ⌥⌘6): see, save and remove the files attached to a PDF, attach your own, and open an attached PDF as its own document; show or hide a document's layers for viewing and printing without changing it, or save what you see as its default. The sidebar's buttons are now icons, with their names when you point at them. - Read Aloud (View menu, ⇧⌘Y): reads from the top of the page in view, or just the selection, with a macOS voice; the sentence and word being read are highlighted and followed. A bar over the pages has pause, stop, previous and next paragraph, the voice and the speed (0.75×-2×). - New PDF from Office File… and from Web Page… (File menu, and the start page's Create a PDF card): Word, Excel and PowerPoint files become PDFs through LibreOffice when it's installed (free, from libreoffice.org); a web address or a saved page is printed to a PDF with your paper, margins and backgrounds. Office files and saved pages also open straight from Finder or File › Open. The result opens as a new PDF; the original isn't changed.

item.title: Inkvolt PDF 1.4.1
item.description:
A security fix for signed documents, and a more honest accessibility check.
- Fixed: a signature could still read as valid after a later change laid something over its page, through a field that only called itself a timestamp or a comment written straight into the page's list. Both now count as changes made after signing. - Accessibility Check no longer calls a file a pass when part of it couldn't be checked (a very long page, forms nested too deep, a huge number of annotations or tags): it says "Not fully checked" and lists what wasn't, in the pane, the report and Batch, where such a file counts as failed.

item.title: Inkvolt PDF 1.4.0
item.description:
Prepare Form, Measure, Save as PDF/A, the accessibility check, Make Accessible and the AI assistant come to Inkvolt PDF for Mac.
- AI assistant (Tools › AI Assistant), off until you turn it on: connect an AI you choose, Ollama or LM Studio on this Mac or a service with your own key (kept in your keychain). Summarize pages, ask about the document in a pane at the right, or Control-click selected text › Explain with AI. Before anything is sent, a window shows where it goes and exactly what goes; answers are marked as AI-generated and link their page citations to the pages. Make Accessible's Reading Order pane can ask it to suggest a picture's alternate text. Inkvolt PDF has no AI of its own and Bermudez Systems receives nothing - Make Accessible (Tools menu): tags a PDF for screen readers on this Mac, nothing sent anywhere: headings, paragraphs, lists, tables, contents, footnotes, formulas and pictures read from the pages, running headers and page numbers set aside, the title and language set. You can undo it until you save. - Reading Order and Alt Text (Tools menu): the order a screen reader follows, as a list and as numbered boxes on the pages. Move a piece by drag, the buttons or ⌥↑ ⌥↓, even to the page before or after; type a picture's alternate text or mark it decorative; Apply Changes tags the document again. - Save as PDF/A-2a (File menu): the archival copy that keeps the tags and says it is accessible. Batch has Make Accessible and Save as PDF/A-2a as actions. - Fixed: Help › Inkvolt Pro… didn't open. - Save as PDF/A now converts documents with Fill & Sign check marks and forms like the IRS's (their usage rights go, and the list of changes says so), and its copies drop pictures' and pages' own metadata, so they pass a formal check. - Prepare Form (Tools menu, ⌥⌘F): make a PDF fillable. Drag text fields, check boxes, radio buttons, dropdowns, list boxes, signature fields and buttons onto the page, then set their names, defaults, formats and order in the panel on the right. Detect Form Fields finds the lines, boxes and underscores to fill in for you. The form fills in Acrobat, browsers and phones too. - Measure (Tools menu): click to measure a distance, a perimeter or an area on drawings and plans, with the value shown by the pointer as you go. Set Measuring Scale… ("1 in = 10 ft", this page or all) or Calibrate from a length you know saves the scale in the PDF, and the scales a drawing already has are used where they apply. Each measurement is a comment labeled with its value, written the way Acrobat and Inkvolt PDF for Windows write them, so it reads the same there. - Accessibility Check… (Tools menu): check a PDF against PDF/UA-1. Each problem says its Matterhorn number, where it is, what's wrong and what fixes it, and choosing it takes you there; a checklist covers what only a person can judge; Save Report… writes it all as one accessible web page. Batch has it as an action. - Save as PDF/A-2b… (File menu): an archival copy of the document as it is now, for records that must open the same in years to come; the open document doesn't change. The copy gets a color profile and PDF/A metadata, loses what archives don't allow (scripts, attached files, password protection, hidden comments), and the standard fonts it uses get embedded. When something can't be kept without changing how the document looks (another font that isn't embedded, CMYK color, a digital signature), nothing is saved and each reason is listed. Batch has it too, as its last change.
For Macs with Apple silicon, macOS 15 or later. Signed with Developer ID and notarized by Apple. Free software under the GNU AGPL v3; source in this repository.

item.title: Inkvolt PDF 1.3.0
item.description:
Compare Files, digital signatures, Batch with presets and watched folders, Reduce File Size, headers, footers, watermarks and Flatten come to Inkvolt PDF for Mac.
- Compare Files… (File menu): pick the original and the changed version (an open document or any PDF) and see them side by side, page by page, with every inserted, removed and changed word marked on both sides and listed to step through. Text that only moved to the next page isn't a change; a removed or added page is one change. Visual overlays the pages (only in the original: red, only in the changed file: blue) for drawings and scans. Annotated Copy makes a copy of the changed file with every change as a comment, to save and share. - Digital signatures: the Signatures pane in the sidebar (View › Show Signatures) checks every signature when you open a PDF and after each change: valid, changed after signing, changed in ways the signature doesn't allow, or invalid, with the signer, the time, the certificate and whether your Mac trusts it. Inkvolt PDF warns before an edit would invalidate a signature. - Sign Digitally… (Tools menu, the Signature tool, or a click on an empty signature field): sign with a digital ID from your keychain (smart cards too), a .p12 file, or a personal ID made for you; drag where the signature goes, choose what it shows (your handwritten signature beside it, if you like), add a trusted timestamp or certify the document, then save the signed copy. - Batch (File menu, and the start page): the same actions on many PDFs and pictures, saved to a folder with names from a template: reduce file size, protect or unprotect, sanitize, redact patterns, check redaction, report what's in each file, watermark, header and footer with Bates numbers, rotate, flatten, recognize text, export to Word, Excel, text, page images or form data. Save the list as a preset, export and import presets (the same files as on Windows), and watch folders: a file dropped in runs through a preset once it has finished copying. - The command line: `InkvoltPdf --batch preset.json files…` and `--watch folder --preset preset.json` run a preset without a window, from a terminal or launchd (`--help` explains). - Reduce File Size… (File menu): pictures downsampled to the chosen resolution, duplicates merged, streams compressed, unused objects dropped. - Add Header & Footer… and Add Watermark… (Pages menu): page numbers, dates, Bates numbers, a text or a picture across the pages, written into them so they print everywhere; Remove takes them off again. - Flatten… (Pages menu): comments and form fields become part of the pages. - Help › Inkvolt Pro…: enter an Inkvolt Pro licence key, see whom it's licensed to, or remove it. Everything in Inkvolt PDF for Mac stays free while it launches, Pro features included; a licence ($19, one time, no account, checked on your Mac and never sent anywhere) supports the project and keeps those features for you when they start asking for a key. One key works on Windows and the Mac.
For Macs with Apple silicon, macOS 15 or later. Signed with Developer ID and notarized by Apple. Free software under the GNU AGPL v3; source in this repository.

item.title: Inkvolt PDF 1.2.0
item.description:
What's in This PDF comes to Inkvolt PDF for Mac.
- Tools › What's in This PDF… (also See What's in It… in Sanitize Document): one report of everything a PDF carries besides its pages: scripts and what they do, web addresses, files and programs it can reach, attachments, metadata, signatures, earlier versions, hidden layers and text, form values. Each item says whether Sanitize removes it. Save it as a web page or JSON. Nothing in the file is contacted. - Edit Text & Images: clicking text on top of a picture edits the text. - Redact by Pattern: a mistake in your own pattern is described in plain words.
For Macs with Apple silicon, macOS 15 or later. Signed with Developer ID and notarized by Apple. Free software under the GNU AGPL v3; source in this repository.

item.title: Inkvolt PDF 1.1.0
item.description:
Redaction and Sanitize come to Inkvolt PDF for Mac.
- Redact areas, selected text, search matches or patterns (Social Security, phone and card numbers, emails, dates, IBANs and your own words), review the marks, then apply: what's under them is removed from the file. - After applying, a redaction check makes sure nothing of what you redacted is left anywhere in the file; Tools › Check Redaction… checks any PDF. - Sanitize Document removes metadata, hidden content, scripts, links, attachments and earlier versions before you share a PDF.
For Macs with Apple silicon, macOS 15 or later. Signed with Developer ID and notarized by Apple. Free software under the GNU AGPL v3; source in this repository.

item.title: Inkvolt PDF 1.0.0
item.description:
The first release of Inkvolt PDF for Mac.
- Read PDFs in tabs, with thumbnails, the outline, find and clickable links. - Comment, highlight and draw; fill in forms; Fill & Sign with your signature. - Edit the text and pictures already on a page. - Make scanned pages searchable (OCR) and export to Word, Excel or text. - Organize pages, add bookmarks, combine files, scan to PDF, protect with a password. - Print with pages per sheet, booklets and posters. - Nothing you open leaves your Mac: no account, no tracking.
For Macs with Apple silicon, macOS 15 or later. Signed with Developer ID and notarized by Apple. Free software under the GNU AGPL v3; source in this repository.
